result.title: PLS-GS: Probabilistic Lidar Scaffolds for Compact, Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting
result.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Main paper and supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/k-harikumar/PLS-GS
result.summary: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is typically optimized from images only, many robotics and mapping applications provide both camera and high-definition LiDAR data, combining rich visual appearance with accurate geometric structure. We introduce PLS-GS, a probabilistic LiDAR scaffold for Gaussian Splatting that exploits this complementary sensing setting to construct a compact 3DGS representation aligned to the measured surface. PLS-GS fits a Hierarchical Gaussian Mixture Model jointly over position and color, yielding a continuous and adaptive scaffold that eliminates the need for discrete scene partitioning such as voxel grids or octrees. The fitted mixture then guides the renderable 3DGS Gaussians: each rendering Gaussian is associated with a GMM component and constrained in the local surface frame induced by that component's covariance. A Mahalanobis support loss bounds the deviation of the rendering Gaussians from the corresponding LiDAR-derived surface. Across five large outdoor scenes, PLS-GS places primitives markedly closer to the LiDAR measurements than both image- and LiDAR-initialized baselines, while employing substantially fewer primitives, yielding a considerably more compact model and faster rendering. At matched capacity, PLS-GS places primitives closer to the LiDAR measurements, with comparable rendering quality. Code is available at https://github.com/k-harikumar/PLS-GS.

AI.brief_summary: PLS-GS 用位置与颜色的层次高斯混合模型拟合 LiDAR 点云作为概率支架，约束渲染高斯贴近实测表面，从而在室外场景获得更紧凑、渲染更快的 3DGS 表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向三维重建与渲染的表示紧凑化，不涉及多模态推理状态生成、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，未提供可迁移到 LVR 的具体线索。
